description: Omega one consists of the countable ordinals and is a limit beyond omega plus one.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.ChoicePrinciples.first_uncountable_spec.{u} :
  (∀ (a : Ordinal.{u}), a < Ordinal.omega 1 ↔ Countable a.ToType) ∧
    Order.IsSuccLimit (Ordinal.omega 1) ∧ Ordinal.omega0 + 1 < Ordinal.omega 1
